text_description: Cropped runway-style look centered on the torso to below the knee: an open, longline dark navy-black tweed coat with a dense nubby texture and light speckling frames the outfit, falling past the skirt with raw-looking fringed trim along the front edges, hem, and cuffs. Pale greenish decorative buttons sit along the coat opening and sleeve edge, and a light beige printed lining is visible inside where the coat swings open. Underneath, a black top is partially visible at the chest, layered with a pale gray-white vertical panel or scarf-like piece hanging down the front. The bottom is a high-waisted, close-fitting tweed pencil skirt in gray, black, and off-white horizontal mélange striations, cut to around knee length with an asymmetrical wrap-like front overlap. A deep front slit opens on one side, exposing the thigh and knee, while the diagonal overlapping edge is finished with fringe that echoes the coat trim. The proportions are structured and polished: heavy textured outerwear over a slim skirt, with the open coat creating vertical lines around the body. One hand carries a small structured cream handbag with bold black trim and a darker burgundy side or handle detail. Footwear and the full upper neckline are not visible.
